name: attn_scores
summary: causal attention scores S[i][j] = 0.125 * sum_c Q[i][c] K[j][c] for j <= i, S[i][j] = -1e30f for j > i; Q, K are T x Dh with Dh = 64 so 1/sqrt(Dh) = 0.125 is exact

s.why: unmasked entry: a length-Dh dot product in any order, with or without FMA, is within gamma(Dh) * sum_c |q_c k_c| of the exact value (Higham Thm 3.1/3.5); the scale 0.125 = 2^-3 is exact both before and after the sum, so reference.py passes 0.125 * sum_c |q_c k_c| as the scale. WolframLanguageEvaluator: u=2^-24; g[n_]:=n u/(1-n u); N[g[64],10] -> 3.814711818*10^-6. Masked entry (j > i): scale 0 and atol 0, so it must equal float32(-1e30) exactly. A dropped term moves an entry by |q_c k_c|, far above 3.8e-6 of the row sum.
